scenes.title: Past Life · The Borrowed Pen
scenes.summary: In her past life, before the final SAT section, Shen Man asks Lin Zhixia to lend her a pen. Lin hands one over without thinking. When Shen Man returns it, her fingertip pauses on the barrel for half a second.
scenes.text: Before the final SAT section. Outside the testing hall. Lin Zhixia murmurs essay material to herself. Shen Man walks up: "Zhixia, lend me a pen. Mine just ran dry." Lin Zhixia pulls one from her pencil case and hands it over. Shen Man takes it, scribbles twice on scratch paper, gives it back: "Thanks. This one writes nice." Lin Zhixia doesn't think twice. She doesn't see it — when Shen Man returns the pen, her fingertip pauses on the barrel for half a second.

scenes.title: Past Life · Score Night
scenes.summary: On past-life SAT score night, Lin Zhixia sees 1120 and files a score verification request with ScoreSync, which is denied. Shen Man tops the school with 1580, the pale blue barcode mark inside her wrist fading.
scenes.text: Late night. Lin Zhixia logs into her ScholarTrack account. The screen flashes her SAT composite: "1120." She refreshes a dozen times. Her hands shake harder each time. Her mother leans in, looks once, and drops into a chair. Her homeroom teacher, Old Chen, is stunned on the phone: "Impossible. I've taught for twenty years... I'll file a score verification request with ScoreSync right now." Three days later the request is denied. The reply is four words: Data verified. Meanwhile, Shen Man tops the school with a "1580" SAT score. In an interview she says, "I just had a good day" — then her eyes go blank for a second. She glances down at the hand that took the pen: inside her wrist, a pale blue barcode mark is fading. The comments all praise her: "Rich and she still works this hard."

scenes.title: Past Life · The Rooftop
scenes.summary: On the past-life NCAC match deadline, Shen Man admits on the rooftop that borrowing the pen triggered ScoreSync to swap SAT scores and alter admissions indexes, then pushes Lin Zhixia off, staging it as suicide.
scenes.text: The day of the NCAC match deadline. An anonymous text lures her to the rooftop. Shen Man drops all pretense: "You think I got here on my father? His five hundred grand bought people inside ScholarTrack to change data. The score — I swapped it myself." Lin Zhixia: "You?" Shen Man holds out her hand. The pale blue barcode mark inside her wrist is so faint it's almost gone: "That pen of yours wrote nice. Guess why I had to borrow yours?" Lin Zhixia turns to leave — to report it, to call the police. Footsteps close behind. Two hands shove hard against her back. In the rushing wind of the fall, Shen Man's voice drifts down from the rooftop edge: "Next life, don't lend your pen to just anyone." What the world called suicide was murder, start to finish.

scenes.title: Rebirth · The Switch
scenes.summary: Lin Zhixia wakes on the first morning of the NCAC exam, writes three plans, and places Zhou Yu's forgotten pen in the outermost pocket of her pencil case.
scenes.text: She opens her eyes. It's the first morning of the NCAC exam. The admission ticket on the desk, her mother's porridge at the door, the date on her phone — exactly as she remembers. Lin Zhixia pinches the back of her hand. It hurts. She sits for ten minutes, then writes three lines in her notebook: "One, she borrows the pen to trigger ScoreSync to swap SAT scores. The pen is the biometric anchor. Two, don't lend her my pen. Three, that push on the rooftop — this time she hits air. And I record it." She closes the notebook and checks her pencil case: her own pen, a spare, and one Zhou Yu left on her desk last week. She puts Zhou Yu's pen in the outermost pocket.

scenes.title: Rebirth · The Testing Hall
scenes.summary: Before the final section in her new life, Shen Man borrows a pen again. Lin Zhixia hands over Zhou Yu's pen. When Shen Man returns it, her fingertip pauses half a second again.
scenes.text: Before the final section, Shen Man comes over, just as expected: "Zhixia, lend me a pen. Mine ran dry." Lin Zhixia smiles and pulls the pen from the outermost pocket: "Here." Shen Man takes it, scribbles twice on scratch paper. Lin Zhixia notices her grip is strange — like she's feeling for something. When she returns it, her fingertip pauses on the barrel for half a second — exactly like the past life. Lin Zhixia takes it back, drops it in her pencil case, and never touches that pen again.

scenes.title: Replay · Score Night
scenes.summary: On score night in her new life, Lin Zhixia sees 1580 on ScholarTrack, Zhou Yu sees 1120, and Shen Man gets only 980 and posts about it in the class group.
scenes.text: Score night. Lin Zhixia logs into ScholarTrack. Her SAT score pops up: 1580 — exactly what she estimated. She stares for a few seconds, refreshes. Still 1580. Her phone rings. Zhou Yu's voice shakes: "Zhixia, I got 1120. But I estimated around 980!" She grips the phone, starts to smile, then stops halfway. Meanwhile the class group explodes: Shen Man posts a screenshot of her ScholarTrack score — "980. How is this possible?" The comments go silent for a long time. Someone asks carefully: "Man, did the system mess up?" Shen Man doesn't reply again.

scenes.title: Zhou Yu's Score
scenes.summary: After Zhou Yu's score verification request to NAAP goes nowhere, she confronts Lin Zhixia. Shen Man barges in and slips up, revealing she knew the original score. Lin Zhixia admits she deliberately lent Zhou Yu's pen to Shen Man. Zhou Yu leaves in fury.
scenes.text: The next day, Zhou Yu rushes into Lin Zhixia's home, eyes red: "I filed a score verification request with NAAP. They say my 1120 is correct. But I estimated barely over three hundred!" Before Lin Zhixia can speak, Shen Man pushes through the door. She snatches Zhou Yu's phone, sees 1120, and blurts out: "You only had 980!" Zhou Yu fires back: "Scores just came out. How do you know what I had before?" Shen Man's face changes. She slams the phone down and walks out. Zhou Yu turns to Lin Zhixia: "Zhixia, do you know something?" A long silence. Then Lin Zhixia speaks: "That pen. The one she borrowed. It was yours." Zhou Yu freezes: "What pen?" "On SAT day she borrowed a pen. I handed her yours." Zhou Yu's face slowly changes: "You did it on purpose?" Lin Zhixia doesn't deny it. "So you protected yourself and pushed me out?" Lin Zhixia: "I didn't think it would go this way. I thought she was swapping—" "You thought? That was my SAT score. What do you mean, you thought?" The door closes. Lin Zhixia sits in the dark and doesn't turn on the light for a long time.

scenes.title: Rooftop · Closing the Net
scenes.summary: Lin Zhixia confronts Shen Man on the rooftop, threatening her with the ScoreSync offline logs to confess the swap. Shen Man lunges and hits the railing. Police, Zhou Yu, and Old Song arrive.
scenes.text: That night, Shen Man calls, voice trembling: "It was you. You switched my pen." Lin Zhixia: "I didn't switch anything. I just didn't lend you mine." "Do you know how long I prepared?!" "Zhou Yu prepared longer." Three seconds of silence. "You're dead." Next night, eight o'clock, the rooftop. Lin Zhixia goes: a sports camera clipped to her backpack strap, a recorder hidden in her sleeve. Zhou Yu waits in the stairwell — not to help her, but to hear Shen Man admit the ScoreSync swap herself and take back her score. Shen Man comes up holding a pen: "Do you know what this is? The moment I write your name—" "Write it." Lin Zhixia cuts her off. "You swapped Zhou Yu once. Swap me again, and that's two records in the NAAP logs. You can delete the server data. You can't delete the offline backup. You have one choice: admit the ScoreSync swap and give Zhou Yu her score back." Shen Man lunges. Lin Zhixia steps aside. Shen Man can't stop herself and slams into the railing. Footsteps thunder up the stairwell — police, Zhou Yu, and Old Song, the technician the Shen family fired, holding printouts of the NAAP system logs.

scenes.title: The Logs
scenes.summary: Three days earlier, Lin Zhixia found Old Song. He shows her the ScoreSync offline logs: borrower Shen Man, pen-owner Zhou Yu, swap successful, and a flag reading target error, rollback advised. Zhou Yu learns the system marked her as advised to ignore.
scenes.text: Three days earlier, Lin Zhixia knocked on Old Song's door. In her past life, during score week, a forum post from someone claiming to be NAAP internal was deleted within seconds. She memorized the ID. This life, she followed it. Old Song spreads the printouts on the table: an unsigned anomaly module, codename "ScoreSwap," with only two fields — "Borrower: Shen Man. Pen-owner: Zhou Yu. Swap status: Successful." Three days later, a new line appears: "Target error. Rollback advised." Lin Zhixia: "The system knows it swapped the wrong person." Old Song: "The system isn't stupid. It just doesn't care." Zhou Yu stands in the doorway, voice barely audible: "So my score was marked 'advised to ignore'?" Old Song says nothing. He slides the USB drive across the table.

scenes.title: The Trial
scenes.summary: Police open a case. Shen Man's lawyer argues the system doesn't exist. The prosecution submits three pieces of evidence. The judge asks Shen Man why her first reaction after seeing her score was to call Lin Zhixia, not file for verification.
scenes.text: Police open a case. Shen Man's lawyer argues, "The so-called system doesn't exist at all." The prosecution submits three things: Old Song's offline logs, the rooftop recording, and a screenshot of Shen Man's post from score night. In court, the judge asks Shen Man: "You saw 330. Why was your first reaction to call Lin Zhixia, not to file for score verification?" Shen Man opens her mouth. Nothing comes out. Lin Zhixia sits in the gallery and doesn't look at her.

scenes.title: Settlement
scenes.summary: Officials announce Shen Man's arrest for using the illegal ScoreSwap module to tamper with NAAP data, her father investigated for a $500,000 bribe to ScholarTrack insiders, and the Shen Group bankrupt. ScoreSwap is handed to investigators. Zhou Yu's score is restored, but the two can't go back.
scenes.text: Official statement: Shen Man used the illegal module "ScoreSwap" to breach the NAAP system and tamper with standardized test data. Charged with unauthorized access to a protected computer system and attempted murder, she is taken into custody. Her father is investigated for a $500,000 bribe to ScholarTrack insiders to alter admissions indexes. The bribery chain is exposed. The Shen Group's stock falls seven straight days, the banks call in their loans, and the company declares bankruptcy. "ScoreSwap" is of unknown origin and has been handed to a specialized agency for investigation. Zhou Yu's score is restored based on her answer sheet. The day the admission letter arrives, she sends Lin Zhixia a message: "My score is back. But we can't go back." Lin Zhixia stares at the screen for a long time and replies with one word: "Yeah."

scenes.title: Epilogue
scenes.summary: Lin Zhixia receives her admission letter, exchanges messages with Zhou Yu about their majors, and keeps Zhou Yu's pen as a warning.
scenes.text: The day Lin Zhixia's admission letter arrives, her mother wipes the envelope three times before daring to open it. Her phone lights up. A message from Zhou Yu: "I applied for education. I'll be a teacher. No one swaps a student's score on my watch." Lin Zhixia smiles and types back: "I applied for law." "Why?" "Because the system is still out there. Someone has to watch it." She places the pen — Zhou Yu's pen — under the glass on her desk, with a sticky note pressed beside it: "This time, every point is mine. Next time, no one takes it." But she doesn't throw the pen away. The system didn't disappear. It just changed its shape, waiting for the next person who lends a pen.
